note: 2026-09-16 P6. The 25 Mar 62 source assembles under macro1 with EIGHT declared transformations (harness/prep_macro1.py T3-T8; the star tables come from Landsteiner's 2014 RECONSTRUCTION, a different provenance grade, named there). Headless simh has no Type 30 display: the program loads (word 6 = 720004 = tyi, from the PDP-1 manual), runs ~2000 instructions, compiles its outline programs at runtime and stops in an infinite I/O wait on the IOH that follows its first display instruction -- the historically correct behaviour for a machine with no scope. RUNNABLE_EMULATED means exactly that; BEHAVIOR_REPRODUCED needs a display build. TECHNE-87b (2026-09-16): image switched to the :display variant (same pinned simh + SDL2 + xvfb). Run 1 is the NEGATIVE control (DPY disabled -> IOH wait, as before); run 2 enables the Type 30, screenshots two frames 300k steps apart and requires lit pixels in [20, 20000] and differing frames -- BEHAVIOR_REPRODUCED: the 1962 program draws the heavy star and both ships.
